MyThemes.Name: My themes
MyThemes.Label: Choose
MyThemes.Hint: Your mood and the music that plays when you speak.

Config.Title: Hero's Theme
Config.SourceFoundryHint: A theme plays while Foundry shows its player as speaking. Players join the audio/video chat with their microphone on; voice activation and push-to-talk both work.
Config.BridgeHint: WebSocket URL and token of your bridge. Both are stored in this browser only; only the GM connects.
Config.PlayersHint: The fallback theme plays only when a player has not chosen a theme of their own. Players pick their own themes and mood; characters get theirs from the Hero's Theme entry in the sheet header. Untick On to stop someone triggering themes.
Config.AllowUploadsHint: Changes Foundry's role permissions (Upload Files and Use File Browser) for the Player and Trusted Player roles. Without it, players can only choose sounds that are already in their playlist.

Notify.MissingBridge: Hero's Theme: set the bridge URL and token under Table setup in the module settings.
Notify.InvalidConfig: Hero's Theme: invalid configuration. Check that each Discord user ID has 15 to 22 digits and is used only once.
Notify.Refused: Hero's Theme: the bot refused the connection. Check the bridge token and module version.
Notify.AvDisabled: Hero's Theme: Foundry's audio/video chat is off in this world. Turn it on under Configure Settings → Core → Configure Audio/Video so themes can follow who is speaking.
Notify.AvUnavailable: Hero's Theme: could not follow Foundry's audio/video chat, so speech cannot be detected. Reload the page; if this keeps happening, another module may be replacing the camera views.

Themes.MoodHint: Your theme changes with your mood. You can also change it from the Players list.
Themes.NoSounds: There are no sounds to choose from yet. Add music to a playlist first.
Themes.HintUser: Moods left on None use your Default theme. A character with its own themes takes priority while you control its token.
Themes.HintActor: Plays when whoever controls this character's token speaks. Moods left on None use this character's Default theme, then the speaker's own themes.
Themes.PlaylistHint: Add your own tracks to this playlist, then pick them above.
Themes.UploadDisabled: Uploading files is disabled for players. Ask the GM to enable it, or choose from the sounds already available.
Themes.NoPlaylist: You do not have a playlist yet. It is created the next time the GM is online, as long as Hero's Theme is on for you.
